remarks: 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, plus detached bonus quarters with its own bathroom, a permitted enclosed patio, a two-car garage, and an extra-long gated driveway with possible RV parking. Owned solar, new fencing installed in 2026, central heating and air conditioning, copper plumbing, and dual-pane windows highlight this well-loved Midtown Ventura home just blocks from the beach. Freshly refinished original hardwood floors and new interior paint complement vaulted living room ceilings, skylights, and a copper-and-tile fireplace.
